 Dense Fog Advisory is in effect Butter sold in 10 states recalled over possible yeast, mold and E. coli contamination 
 Safety in the food chain: Watchdog raises alarm over food recall process (Source: InvestigateTV) By Amanda Alvarado Published : Oct. 28, 2026 at 7:27 AM CDT | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google (Gray News) - Butter is being recalled because it might be contaminated with yeast, mold and E. coli, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. 
 More than 1,300 cases of Miyoko’s Creamery European Style Salted Plant Milk Butter have been recalled in Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, New Jersey, New Hampshire and Wisconsin. 
 The recalled butter has lot code 07871 and a best-by date of Nov. 5, 2026. 
 If you have the butter, you should not eat it, but the recall notice did not give further information about refunds.
